command:
"""One authorized diagnostic; regenerate setup without building in an isolated clone."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import uuid

production = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/lean-build/workspaces/managed-9dff90d84fc5-315a5e4a9466/lean")
relative = Path("Aglib/AlgebraicGeometry/Cohomology/Cech/Comparison.lean")
module = "Aglib.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.Cech.Comparison"
expected = "a9ff484188f60dc58dfe142249bc28ed0cf9fbde1280020dba63d2c5b9a76e8a"
base = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/lean-build")
assert shutil.disk_usage(base).free >= 10 * 1024**3
source_receipt = (production.parent / "SOURCE.json").read_bytes()
assert json.loads(source_receipt)["content_sha256"] == "94ff0139b4121437ff5e1fe111ffcf557a15e479e541a51a1506045fdc2721a8"
assert hashlib.sha256((production / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
scratch = base / "scratch/etale-cech-profile-once" / uuid.uuid4().hex
scratch.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
overlay = scratch / "package"
overlay.mkdir()
subprocess.run(["cp", "--reflink=always", "-a", str(production) + "/.", str(overlay)], check=True)
for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(overlay, followlinks=False):
    for name in dirs + files:
        path = Path(directory) / name
        if not path.is_symlink():
            continue
        resolved = path.resolve(strict=False)
        if resolved.is_relative_to(production):
            destination = overlay / resolved.relative_to(production)
            path.unlink()
            path.symlink_to(os.path.relpath(destination, path.parent))
for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(overlay, followlinks=False):
    for name in dirs + files:
        path = Path(directory) / name
        assert not (path.is_symlink() and path.resolve(strict=False).is_relative_to(production))
source = overlay / relative
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
run_dir = Path(os.environ["LEAN_SYSROOT"]).parent
events = run_dir / "compiler-events.jsonl"
def compiler_starts():
    if not events.exists():
        return 0
    return sum(json.loads(line).get("event") == "started" for line in events.read_text().splitlines())
assert compiler_starts() == 0
lake = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/lean-build/elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.1/bin/lake")
setup_command = [str(lake), "--no-build", "setup-file", str(source)]
prep = subprocess.run(setup_command, cwd=overlay, capture_output=True, text=True)
(scratch / "setup.stdout.log").write_text(prep.stdout)
(scratch / "setup.stderr.log").write_text(prep.stderr)
assert compiler_starts() == 0, "setup unexpectedly invoked a compiler; no profile permitted"
preparation = {
    "kind": "reconstructed native setup, not original fa261 bytes",
    "scratch": str(scratch), "production_source_receipt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_receipt).hexdigest(),
    "source_sha256": expected, "module": module, "setup_command": setup_command,
    "setup_exit_code": prep.returncode, "preparation_compiler_starts": compiler_starts(),
    "profile_invocations": 0,
}
(scratch / "preparation.json").write_text(json.dumps(preparation, indent=2) + "\n")
print("PROFILE_SCRATCH=" + str(scratch), flush=True)
if prep.returncode != 0:
    print(json.dumps(preparation), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(prep.returncode)
setup = json.loads(prep.stdout)
assert setup["name"] == module
setup_bytes = (json.dumps(setup, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
assert str(production) not in setup_bytes.decode(), "reconstructed setup still references production tree"
setup_path = scratch / "Comparison.setup.json"
setup_path.write_bytes(setup_bytes)
output = scratch / "outputs"
output.mkdir()
lean = Path(os.environ["LEAN_SYSROOT"]) / "bin/lean"
command = [str(lean), "-M12800", "-j4", str(source), "--setup", str(setup_path),
           "-Dtrace.profiler=true", "-Dtrace.profiler.threshold=100",
           "-o", str(output / "Comparison.olean"), "-i", str(output / "Comparison.ilean"),
           "-c", str(output / "Comparison.c")]
preparation.update(profile_invocations=1, setup_sha256=hashlib.sha256(setup_bytes).hexdigest(),
                   setup_options=setup.get("options"), command=command,
                   original_setup_byte_identity="unavailable; not claimed")
(scratch / "preparation.json").write_text(json.dumps(preparation, indent=2) + "\n")
started = time.monotonic()
with (scratch / "profile.stdout.log").open("w") as stdout, (scratch / "profile.stderr.log").open("w") as stderr:
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=overlay, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
preparation.update(profile_exit_code=result.returncode, wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
                   observed_compiler_starts=compiler_starts())
assert (production.parent / "SOURCE.json").read_bytes() == source_receipt
assert hashlib.sha256((production / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
assert compiler_starts() == 1
(scratch / "profile.json").write_text(json.dumps(preparation, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(preparation, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
